Bear markets often create the best investing opportunities, but only if you understand valuations. In this video, Karthik Rangappa shares a simple Excel-based framework to quickly assess whether a stock is reasonably valued, overvalued, or undervalued. Using examples from both new-age and mature companies, he explains how to work backwards from market expectations and develop a practical sense of valuation. It's a simple approach that can help you make more informed investing decisions without getting lost in complex financial models.
